description: This file is a C++ source implementation for the RDKShell plugin, which manages application and client lifecycle, event handling, and communication with external services via Thunder. It contains includes, constants, class definitions, thread handling, state management, and function implementations for launching, activating, deactivating, and monitoring clients and applications within the RDK platform.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A dispatch class for executing work functions asynchronously, used with the Thunder framework.

classes.name: JSONRPCDirectLink
classes.description: A class for handling synchronous JSONRPC calls to other services or plugins.

classes.name: StateControlNotification
classes.description: Implements notifications for application state changes, handling focus, suspension, and hibernation events.

classes.name: ScreenCapture
classes.description: Handles capturing screenshots of the display, storing image data, and providing callbacks for screen capture events.

classes.name: HibernateExecutor
classes.description: Manages scheduling, execution, and aborting of application hibernation routines, executing them in a dedicated thread.

classes.name: RDKShell
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing application lifecycle, event handling, display management, configuration, and system control for RDKShell.

classes.name: RdkShellListener
classes.description: Listener class that handles application and system events, such as launch, connection, disconnection, suspension, focus changes, power key events, and system warnings.

methods.name: lockRdkShellMutex
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the main mutex for thread safety; tries with a timeout, then locks normally if unavailable.

methods.description: Converts a client or surface name to lowercase for normalization purposes.

methods.name: ignoreResidentAppLaunch
methods.description: Determines if ResidentApp should be launched based on factory mode and first activation conditions.

methods.name: handleDeactivated
methods.description: Handles client deactivation: cleanup, removing listeners, managing plugin data, and preparing for application shutdown.

methods.description: Handles activation of clients or services.

methods.name: handleDeinitialized

methods.description: System and plugin initialization routine, setting environment variables, loading configs, setting up display and event loop.

methods.name: deinitialize

methods.name: pluginEventHandler
methods.description: General event handler for plugin events such as power state changes, mapping them to application actions.

methods.name: getThunderControllerClient

methods.name: invokeStartupThunderApis
methods.description: Invokes Thunder RPC APIs based on loaded startup configuration and RFC parameters.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Performs full plugin cleanup including threads, event listeners, stored data, and system reset.
